category_title: Adolescents who engage in truant behavior to maintain peer connections during school transitions
scenario_title: Ninth-grade transition and truancy to maintain peer connections
minimal_context: Angelica is expected to complete general classroom instruction assignments early in her ninth-grade year.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your assignment and begin working on the reading questions for today's lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is boring. I don't see why we have to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to get through the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's pointless. I don't even want to be in this class without my friend.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay in your seat and finish the work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I'm cutting this class. I'm going to find my friend instead of staying here.

task.content: General classroom instruction and curriculum mastery across various subjects

context.environment: Transition to a new high school in ninth grade
context.social_setting: Regular school campus and alternative education setting

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Difficulty making new friends in a transition to a new high school
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Began to cut classes early in the year, acting out on purpose to be near her only friend, and trespassing on a regular school campus while placed at the alternative school

behavior_patterns.condition: When experiencing boredom and disconnect with teachers
